_comment: linkup-native arm: the agent picks depth, dates and domains per search via the linkup_search tool (see LINKUP_TOOL / LINKUP_GUIDE in scripts/run_eval.py). depth = fallback if the agent omits it. teams.<team>.prioritize_domains = soft defaults merged into every standard/deep search for that team (the fund knows the user's team from their login; no gold labels are read). Tune on dev only, then freeze before --split test.
